title: START: Vivek Sah, CEO & Founder, Contextflo: "Your team already uses AI. Give it access to your business data."
summary: START: Vivek Sah, CEO & Founder, Contextflo: "Your team already uses AI. Give it access to your business data."

‍


An AI agent can know how to query your database without knowing how your business calculates revenue.


That distinction is at the heart of what Vivek Sah is building at Contextflo.


At his previous startup, one or two data specialists supported operations and marketing teams that regularly needed access to business data. Even relatively simple questions meant interrupting someone on the data team.


As AI agents became more capable, Vivek saw an opportunity to eliminate that bottleneck.


He documented the company's business context, connected an agent to BigQuery and experimented with giving employees direct access to their data.


The early results were promising, but working with customers exposed a fundamental challenge: AI was returning inconsistent revenue figures.


The solution was to give agents a deeper understanding of the business, including how metrics are calculated, how queries should be structured and how business definitions evolve over time.


Today, Contextflo enables employees to access company data directly through AI tools they already use, like Claude and ChatGPT, with built-in access controls and verifiable SQL queries behind every answer.


The results are compelling.


At Tilt, a live auction marketplace, Contextflo reduced the time it takes to answer data questions from 3–5 days to 2–5 minutes. The company now runs approximately 6,000 queries per month.


At Evana, the platform saves the team approximately 20 hours per week on data preparation.


Vivek recognized early that the biggest barrier to AI-powered analytics wasn't necessarily the capability of the models. It was their understanding of the business.


Contextflo is bridging that gap, giving employees the autonomy to answer their own questions and data teams more time to focus on higher-value work.
